messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Ops Sales (Orion Cloud) <ops@orioncloud.com>, Liu Wei <wei.liu@taiyun-oem.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Tranche allocation and OEM slot confirmation for dedicated pool (AcmeAI)

Team,

Following up on the AcmeAI committed-dedicated deal (RDW-ACME-2025-42): they want a staged onramp — 40% capacity in Q3 (target start: 2025-09-01), remaining 60% by Q1 2026. We need confirmation from both cloud and OEM sides on lead times and whether vendor slots can be locked to match this tranche schedule.

Please see the attached tranche matrix (acme_tranche_matrix_v1.xlsx) for the breakdown I proposed. High-level asks: 
- Orion: can you hold a hot-backfill buffer (~10% of Q3 tranche) across our reserved pool if there are shipment delays? What are the contractual steps to reserve that buffer?
- Taiyun (Liu): confirm earliest build window you can commit for the first tranche GPUs and estimated ship ETA to our US datacenter. Also include quote for expedited slot (if available) and any MOQ constraints.

Timing is tight — Acme expects a formal capacity plan for their procurement review by 5/20. Can we get vendor confirmation by EOD 5/14 so I can incorporate into the mutual action plan?

Thanks,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: acme_tranche_matrix_v1.xlsx
From: Ops Sales (Orion Cloud) <ops@orioncloud.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Kai Chen <kai.chen@acmeai.com>
Date: Mon, 12 May 2025 14:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Tranche allocation and OEM slot confirmation for dedicated pool (AcmeAI)

Karthik / Vanessa,

Thanks for the heads-up. Short answers first: yes, we can provision a 10% hot-backfill buffer for Q3 tranche under a short-term top-up agreement; and yes, we have reservation lanes that can be earmarked for 'enterprise backfill' with a 30-day notice window. The contractual path is an addendum to the existing reserved capacity contract (we'll need a PO for the buffer and an agreed burn-down cadence).

Couple of follow-ups: 
- Buffer pricing: +12% on top of standard reserved unit rate for the buffer tranche.
- Network egress: if Acme uses cross-region staging during initial ramp, we need to lock egress caps — otherwise usage could spike.
- Capacity handover: we require an activation ticket 14 business days prior to live traffic start.

Attached is a short checklist (we'll push formal addendum language once vendor-side ETA is confirmed).

Regards,
Jordan Li
Enterprise Sales, Orion Cloud
ops@orioncloud.com

Attachments: orion_buffer_checklist_0512.pdf
From: Liu Wei <wei.liu@taiyun-oem.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, Kai Chen <kai.chen@acmeai.com>
Date: Tue, 13 May 2025 09:25:00 +0800
Subject: Re: Tranche allocation and OEM slot confirmation for dedicated pool (AcmeAI)

Hi Karthik and Ben,

Thanks for the tranche plan. We can commit to the following preliminary slots: 
- Tranche A (Q3 start): 160 units, build window 2025-07-10 to 2025-07-30, ETA to US datacenter: 2025-08-25 to 2025-09-05 depending on freight routing.
- Tranche B (Q4/Q1 follow-on): contingent slot 2025-11-01 to 2025-11-20 with ETA 2025-12-15 to 2026-01-10.

Expedited slot available for Tranche A at +8% premium; MOQ for expedited is 80 units. Lead times assume no additional customs delays — current port congestion in Shenzhen adds ~7-10 days variance.

I've attached the formal slot quote (taiyun_oem_slot_quote_0512.pdf). Please note quote validity: 14 calendar days. To lock slots we need a signed slot reservation form plus 20% deposit against Tranche A.

If Acme needs full containerized shipping to a specific US port, we can provide updated ETA within 48 hours once port is selected.

Best,
Liu Wei
Sr. Customer Solutions Manager | Taiyun OEM
wei.liu@taiyun-oem.com

Attachment: taiyun_oem_slot_quote_0512.pdf
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Kai Chen <kai.chen@acmeai.com>, Ops Sales (Orion Cloud) <ops@orioncloud.com>, Liu Wei <wei.liu@taiyun-oem.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 14 May 2025 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Tranche allocation and OEM slot confirmation for dedicated pool (AcmeAI)

Thanks all — good progress. Summary / agreed next steps (for mutual action plan):

1) OEM slot: Taiyun provisionally commits Tranche A (160 units) with build window 7/10-7/30 and ETA late Aug — early Sep. To lock this: Acme to sign reservation form and provide 20% deposit by 5/20. (Attachment: taiyun_oem_slot_quote_0512.pdf)

2) Expedited option: available for Tranche A (MOQ 80 units) at +8% premium. Acme to confirm if they want expedited subset by 5/18.

3) Cloud buffer: Orion will hold a 10% hot-backfill buffer; addendum needed. Karthik/Vanessa will loop legal and ops to prepare PO/addendum language — target sign-off 5/27 to meet activation ticket timeline.

4) Logistics: Once Acme confirms port preference, Taiyun to confirm final ETA within 48 hours. Shipping variances noted (customs/port congestion).

5) Docs: I will incorporate the confirmed slots, buffer pricing, and deposit milestone into the mutual action plan and share an updated PDF by 5/16.

Action owners: 
- Acme (Kai): confirm deposit decision & expedited subset by 5/18.
- Taiyun (Liu): hold slot for 14 days pending deposit; provide final shipping ETA once port selected.
- Orion (Jordan): draft buffer addendum skeleton and pricing note by 5/16.
- Redwood (Karthik/Vanessa): produce revised MAP and attach quotes by 5/16.

If anyone sees a timing gap that risks Q3 start, flag it now.

Thanks,
Karthik
